_about: HCKIT6 v100 (HC3 K10b/c): the shape generators of the blood and wound art, read by Combat/BloodShapes.cs (DataPath: StreamingAssets first in the player). Every number is the literal that BloodBurst / WoundDecals.MakeMask / BloodGround.MakeSplat / BloodEdge.MakeStrip held in code up to v95 (tools/hckit6_selftest.py proves json == old literals). [lo, hi] = a random range (lo + (hi - lo) * rnd). Colours, counts per hit weight and ground sizes stay in blood.json, wounds.json, hit_feel.json and blood_edge.json; this file is only the SHAPE of what is drawn. Presentation only.

burst._about: BloodBurst (V3 blood-style.ts): hitCount / killCount particles per landed hit, the first hitDrops / killDrops are heavy drops (drop), the rest a thin spray (spray). Width x Thin (= product of thinFactors), strand length x Long (= longNumer product / longDenom product). gravity 8 m/s2 over gravityRef 9.81. front / minCam / growMax / pullHeight = the foe burst is pulled toward the camera. alphaKeys = alpha, time pairs of the colour-over-lifetime gradient.

wound._about: WoundDecals.MakeMask. Puncture = round hole (coreR) + a short radial run (runCount blobs, runStart + i * runStep out, radius runR - i * runRStep) + satCount satellite drops. Streak = a tapered gash of seg blobs along x (segX0 + u * segXSpan, wobble, sine), speckCount specks, dripCount short runs below the cut. gain multiplies the mask; texMin / texMax clamp wounds.json decal.texSize.

ground._about: BloodGround.MakeSplat: variants textures, each one main pool (mainR x texture size) + blobBase + rnd*blobRand mid blobs (midR) + pins pin drops (pinR) at dist x texture size from the centre, x stretch sx; reach = blob support radius. stretchY = the splat's length stretch on the floor, hitScatter / hitOffset = placement around the victim, dripMin = wound drip inner radius.

edge._about: BloodEdge.MakeStrip. kinds[0] soft wobbling smear, kinds[1] soft bleed (wide falloff), kinds[2] dragged streaks. reach = reachBase + reachAmp * perlin(v * reachFreq + off, off + reachY) (squared when reachSquare); row = rowBase + rowAmp * perlin(v * rowFreq + off, off + rowY); alpha = (1 - u / reach)^pow (pow 1 = linear). off = seed * seedMul + index * indexMul; vFade = soft top / bottom fade; shade = shadeBase + shadeAmp * perlin(u * shadeFreq + off, v * shadeFreq).
